Help manual

Mix editor

Edit timelines, audition changes, and promote reviewed Takes.

On this page
  • Edit
  • Audition
  • Promote
  • Blank mix

Edit

  1. Open EDIT; choose a mix in the right-hand picker.
  2. Select (V) selects and moves slots; the outgoing slot anchors a Transition. Pan (H) moves the view; Jump (J) edits jumps/pauses.
  3. Open a control lane's breakpoint editor. Click to add nodes, drag to adjust, double-click to delete. Cmd/Ctrl+Z undoes; Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+Z redoes. Saved mixes autosave.

Audition

  1. Press play or Space. Audition uses the shared Decks and Mixer; opening a mix alone does not interrupt playback. Wait while loading, or press again to cancel.
  2. Pause with editor transport. Moving live Deck/Mixer controls takes over playback. Auditions create no Takes.

Promote

  1. An unpromoted Take opens in REVIEW. Edit, audition, then Promote to save a Transition or Routine. Review edits do not persist before promotion; original evidence remains.

Blank mix

  1. Choose + New blank mix; drag Library Tracks onto the canvas. Two slots save as a Transition, three or more as a Routine; fewer than two remain unsaved. Adding or removing a slot across that boundary converts the saved mix; Set pins follow.
